pick.headline: Yuri Andropov dies
pick.summary: On 9 February 1984 Soviet leader Yuri Andropov, who had headed the KGB for fifteen years before succeeding Brezhnev, died after fifteen months in office.
pick.significance: Andropov was the first KGB chairman to become party leader. His death, announced the next day, brought the elderly Konstantin Chernenko to power.
